name: f5-s608
prompt: <image1> shows a creature. Draw the same creature at its next, more grown-up stage. The whole silhouette changes: it leaps in a big round arc like a dolphin jumping, the long body curved like the letter C; the paddle flippers become long rounded coral fins; a low soft coral fin ridge grows along the whole back; the tail ends in a wide soft fluke. Keep the face, the coral cheeks, the three soft coral gill fronds on each side of the head, the cream belly stripe from chin to tail tip and the flat style without outlines; the body is light warm apricot (#FFC56E), not orange. Fins and wings are coral, never turquoise or green. No teeth, no claws. Full body, plain flat pale mint background.
